tickets.subject: Login issues with eSIM portal
tickets.description: Users are experiencing intermittent login failures when accessing the eSIM portal. The error message shows 'Authentication failed' even with correct credentials. This happens approximately 30% of the time during peak hours (9-11 AM and 2-4 PM UTC).

tickets.subject: Billing inquiry for December usage
tickets.description: We need clarification on the billing for December. Our usage report shows 1,250 eSIM activations, but the invoice shows 1,400. Please provide a detailed breakdown of the charges.

tickets.subject: Feature request: Bulk eSIM activation
tickets.description: We would like to request a bulk eSIM activation feature that allows us to activate multiple eSIMs at once through the API. This would significantly improve our operational efficiency when dealing with large enterprise orders.

tickets.subject: API integration documentation request
tickets.description: We need comprehensive documentation for integrating our CRM system with the OneSim API. Specifically, we need examples for customer creation, eSIM ordering, and status tracking.

tickets.subject: Performance issues with dashboard loading
tickets.description: The dashboard is taking 15-20 seconds to load during business hours. This is affecting our team's productivity. The issue started appearing after the recent update last week.

tickets.subject: Account access permissions issue
tickets.description: Some team members cannot access the inventory section even though they have the correct roles assigned. The error message shows 'Insufficient permissions' when trying to view eSIM inventory.
